key_events: Rhea transitioned from a fatal car crash into a mid-air freefall.
She survived a terminal velocity impact thanks to the Tutorial Grace Period.
She discovered she is pinned under heavy obsidian debris.
The System assigned her the title Indentured Soul and a starting Soul Debt of 100,000.
A glowing blue System notification appeared, blocking her vision and demanding acknowledgment of her Indenture Status.
Rhea was trapped under obsidian debris with a System prompt blocking her view.
A passive heat damage timer threatened to drain her final hit point in 12 seconds.
Rhea refused the default terms and found a hidden 'Dismiss' button in the fine print.
Dismissing the prompt canceled the environmental damage and cleared her vision.
Rhea rolled away from a collapsing rock pillar, freeing her trapped leg and removing the Pinned status.
Rhea reached the Crater Ridge and located a glowing Starter Cache pedestal.
A System Prompt offered her basic survival provisions: meager rations, stale water, and a poor flint dagger.
Rhea spotted a microscopic asterisk next to the 'Accept' button, realizing the offer was a trap.
Rhea investigated the microscopic asterisk on the System prompt.
She uncovered a compounding interest rate payable in maximum HP and forced labor.
She explicitly rejected the terms, causing the Starter Cache pedestal to lock and go dark.
Rhea searched the debris around the locked pedestal for a tool.
She discovered and picked up an Obsidian Shard.
She used the shard to strike the glowing stone of the pedestal.
She successfully broke off a Raw Masonry Chunk without triggering a System contract.
Rhea sat in the ash and used the Obsidian Shard to physically carve the Raw Masonry Chunk into a handle.
She cut her hand during the process, proving that the System's 1 HP threshold does not track minor cosmetic bleeding.
Rhea successfully crafted the Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon.
She equipped the weapon, causing the System interface to glitch and flicker purple.
The System recognized the weapon as an unregistered asset and failed to apply a tax assessment, securing Rhea her first debt-free advantage.
